name: a5-100m-pick
setup: set -e; python3 -m venv /opt/p2venv; /opt/p2venv/bin/pip install -q torch==2.7.0 numpy tokenizers==0.21.1 transformers==4.51.3 safetensors matplotlib pytest; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,train_100M,dev; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -x babylm/tests; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; mkdir -p babylm/moonshot; [ -f babylm/moonshot/__init__.py ] || touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py; echo  | base64 -d > babylm/configs/jobs_a5_100m.json; echo '8eff268e9945c674661e7016f80900bd1b92e8372c950cdba7cb8796a1421a05  babylm/configs/jobs_a5_100m.json' | sha256sum -c -
note: A5 pick seeds s1+s2 at E* (critic ref-0189): fill __ESTAR__ = argmin over the s0 grid of cal_t FULL DEV (calib_set.py / calib_control on each run's pt_v2/dev_v2.npz temps dump, K=1, shared-T grid 0.9-1.2), ties to the smaller E; the same E* serves guarded. T100 = mean of s0 (grid run at E*), s1, s2. Config jobs_a5_100m.json written in setup (sha 8eff268e9945; source babylm/results/final_table_lines/jobs_a5_100m.json on the ruler branch). Copy runs/<run>/score/dev_bpw_twin.json + pt_v2 + loss curves to reads.

jobs.name: a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1
jobs.cmd: /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_a5_100m.json --only a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1; rc=$?; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.analysis.post_runs --pt_runs a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1; [ -f babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1 /opt/babylm || echo '[a5] score a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1 failed'; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1 failed'; mkdir -p babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/pt_v2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/pt_v2/dev_v2.npz --check babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1/pt_v2/dump.log 2>&1 || echo '[ptv2] a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s1 failed'; }; exit $rc

jobs.name: a5_S_100M_e__ESTAR___s2
